behavior: AC1: apply installs a declared missing entry and removes an undeclared one through pi install/remove only; a second run changes nothing and calls no pi
AC2: check exits non-zero naming each missing and undeclared entry, and on an unreadable or empty manifest
AC3: every install and removal logs its elapsed time; a failed or slow one prints its output in a fence, and the threshold never stops an install
AC4: DOTFILES_SKIP_PI_PACKAGES skips loudly and exits 0 before any probe; a missing pi or npm warns and exits 0
AC5: a declared retire path moves under ~/.pi/agent/archive/ intact, is never deleted or overwritten, and a second run moves nothing
AC6: the doctor check fails on a declared requirement that does not resolve and passes on the shipped manifest
AC7: both setup twins call dotf pi packages apply, neither carries the reconcile loop, and the CI pi filter covers cli/internal/pi/**, the manifest and both twins
verification: ~/.local/bin/bats -f 'both twins reconcile|neither twin carries|CI pi filter covers the manifest' tests/pi-packages.bats && grep -q "cli/internal/pi/\*\*" .github/workflows/ci.yml

behavior: AC8 (live, msi): pi-memory is not installed, its data is archived, a fresh pi session registers no memory_search tool, and a second apply changes nothing
verification: test "$(jq '.packages' ~/.pi/agent/settings.json | grep -c pi-memory)" = 0 && test ! -e ~/.pi/agent/memory && ls -d ~/.pi/agent/archive/memory-* && out=$(printf '{"type":"get_state"}\n' | pi --mode rpc --no-session 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q '"command":"get_state","success":true' && ! printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q memory_search && dotf pi packages apply | grep -q '0 changed'
